news.title: UW–Madison chancellor special regent committee announces three finalists
news.summary_en: Candidate interviews and forums will be held on the UW–Madison campus next week.

news.title: Hope for the critically endangered northern muriqui monkey
news.summary_en: A new grant is providing $1 million over five years to go directly toward the conservation of Brazil’s peaceful primate population, and UW–Madison researcher Karen Strier will be leading the effort.
